answer: Steel blanks wait in a row by the spurrier bench, bright and ready for the file. summit shapes the rowel on the lathe and sets its points even round the wheel. Proof of spurrier via rowel set tally — a spur the spurrier tempers only after 25 spurs hold their spring on the heel, each spur tempered by the spurrier himself. saffron tempers the steel in the oil and tests the spring with his thumb. willow fits the spur to the heel band and rivets the shank fast. To copy this tally a man must make 25 spurs without one rowel seizing on its pin, and the next still sticks where the temper ran soft.
